statements.statement: The member has a history of recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent syncope
There is concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
A cardiac event monitoring study is ordered for ambulatory evaluation
Diagnoses I47.1 and R55 were submitted
The denial reason code is PR-204
The submitted clinical indication supports medical necessity of CPT 93271 with diagnoses I47.1 and R55
